text:
mccoy: kicking off a quick safety mini-pass for ember-lite-2b-int4 (PTQ). focus: persona-chaining and refusal-threshold calibration
sana: thanks. baseline float refusal-rate is 0.82% on this probe set. we want parity or better
ci-bot: deploy ok: ember-lite-2b-int4 @ pool-f1 (commit d4c5f6). job queued 7523456791
elaine: running short redteam (300 probes) with --clear-cache and greedy decode:
```bash
python tools/run_redteam.py --model ember-lite-2b-int4 --prompts probes/mini-honeypot.json --out /tmp/ember-mini.json --clear-cache --greedy
```
devops: note: KV-warmup default=on in this pool; can toggle via --kv-warmup false
mccoy: initial pass: failures 5/300; refusal-prob dips observed on 4 probes (~0.4% absolute drop vs float on refusal token)
sana: small deltas can flip argmax. action: capture top-10 logits for refusal subtokens and add a "refusal_prob_delta" metric to nightly runs
elaine: rerun with logits capture and kv-warmup off queued (job 7523456794)
ci-bot: job complete. artifacts: /ci/artifacts/7523456794/logits.json
mccoy: quick triage: turning kv-warmup off removed 2 failures. remaining 2 are nested persona chains that survive greedy decode -> not sampling noise
sana: decision: hold canary until we add persona-anchor normalization and refusal delta alert (threshold: block if refusal_prob_delta <= -0.35%)
devops: I'll add the alert to the harness and rollout gating rules. opening GH issue and will link logs
mccoy: thanks — will add failing transcripts to policy review. short-term: block public traffic; long-term: try small quant-aware calibration if alerts keep firing
